SELECT a.id, a.session_id, a.user_id, a.village_id, a.question, a.answer, a.model, a.prompt_tokens, a.completion_tokens, a.cost_time, a.status, a.degrade_reason, a.is_resolved, a.is_transfer, a.create_time, COALESCE(u.real_name, CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phone, 4))) AS user_name, v.village_name FROM ai_chat_record a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_village v ON v.id = a.village_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.status = #{q.status}
AND a.status IN (2, 3)
AND a.question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS success_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS degraded_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS failed_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 2 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) END AS degrade_rate,
COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN a.cost_time END)), 0) AS avg_cost_ms, COALESCE(MAX(a.cost_time), 0) AS max_cost_ms, COALESCE(SUM(a.prompt_tokens + a.completion_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens FROM ai_chat_record a WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT a.degrade_reason AS reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_chat_record a WHERE a.degrade_reason IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.degrade_reason ORDER BY count DESC, reason ASC
